themes.corpus_position: Start low and slow. Low: you are going to use no more than a pea size amount, and that is for your entire face. … Slow: that means you're going to apply it every three nights at first. Do that for a month and then you can use it every two nights for a month, then every night thereafter if your skin feels great. … Also invest in a great barrier repair cream or a diaper cream. Use it whenever your skin is really irritated, peeling, red, angry.

themes.corpus_position: Minoxidil is highly toxic to pets, both cats and dogs. So, if your pets sleep on your head or near your head or on your pillow or they might lick your head or your pillow, these just might be risks that you're not willing to take. Regardless of whether you apply it in the morning or night, you want to make sure it's completely dry and to wash your hands after to protect your pets. Or an alternative is that you talk to your doctor about oral minoxidil instead.

news.headline: FDA approves first treatment for 'skin writing' hives (symptomatic dermographism)
news.summary: Announced Oct 7: Novartis's oral pill Rhapsido (remibrutinib) is now the first FDA-approved treatment for adults whose symptomatic dermographism — hives and itch raised by everyday friction, scratching or rubbing — isn't controlled by antihistamines. In the phase 3 RemIND trial 29.3% were completely hive-free at week 12 versus 14.0% on placebo, with responses as early as week 2. It is a visual, easy-to-demonstrate condition and a gap for you: 0 transcripts mention dermatographia, and your hives explainer is a 13-minute YouTube video from Feb 2023 (5K views). On this shelf for a second day; no tracked creator has picked it up in today's feed.
